SELECT r.*, u.nickname AS user_name, p.title AS paper_title, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_marking m WHERE m.record_id = r.id AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 0) AS subjective_count FROM exam_record r LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.user_id LEFT JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = r.paper_id WHERE r.is_deleted = 0
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
AND r.status = #{status}
ORDER BY r.submit_time DESC, r.id DESC
